pages.title: HTTP workbench
pages.documentTitle: HTTP & REST Workbench: Local Requests and Timing | ProtoPeek
pages.description: Send bounded HTTP and REST requests locally with methods, headers, auth, bodies, TLS verification, redirect control, timing, response evidence, and cURL export.
pages.question: What did this HTTP service actually return?

status.label: Stable · v0.7.0
status.detail: Published v0.7.0 includes environment templates, request libraries and reviewed cURL import. Import prepares an unsent editor; credentials remain session-only.

flow.title: Write one explicit request
flow.detail: Choose the method, URL, query, headers, auth, body, timeout, and redirect policy.

flow.title: Use the local Go relay
flow.detail: ProtoPeek validates a bounded request and keeps TLS verification on by default.

flow.title: Separate response evidence
flow.detail: See status, protocol, peer, headers, body, redirects, truncation, and timing phases.

pages.title: gRPC workbench
pages.documentTitle: gRPC API Workbench: Requests, Streams & Health | ProtoPeek
pages.description: Use ProtoPeek’s local gRPC workbench for reflection, proto files, streaming RPCs, metadata, trailers, Health checks, repeat runs, and saved requests.
pages.question: What happened inside this gRPC call?

status.label: Stable · v0.7.0
status.detail: Published v0.7.0 includes direct Home entry and incremental native RPC evidence. Local cancellation never invents final server status.

flow.title: Open one target
flow.detail: Use reflection, a browser proto folder, host proto paths, or a protoset.

flow.title: Send the native RPC shape
flow.detail: Keep metadata, deadline, TLS choice, payload, stream mode, and cancellation visible.

flow.title: Follow the evidence in order
flow.detail: Inspect headers, response messages, trailers, final status, and observed timing separately.

pages.title: WebSocket and SSE workbench
pages.documentTitle: WebSocket & SSE Client: Live Message Evidence | ProtoPeek
pages.description: Connect to WebSocket or SSE services locally, inspect bounded message timelines, send text or binary WebSocket data, and stop each session explicitly.
pages.question: What is this live service sending?

status.label: Stable · v0.7.0
status.detail: Published v0.7.0 includes WebSocket/SSE. Sessions start only with Connect and stop on Disconnect, navigation or their limits.

flow.title: Choose the native protocol
flow.detail: Enter one WebSocket or SSE endpoint, headers and a finite duration. Connect starts traffic.

flow.title: Inspect the message timeline
flow.detail: Read data, encoding, named SSE events, IDs and the negotiated WebSocket subprotocol.

flow.title: End the finite session
flow.detail: Disconnect or leave the workbench to close the upstream connection. SSE does not retry automatically.

pages.title: Cap’n Proto workbench
pages.documentTitle: Cap’n Proto RPC Client: Schemas, TLS & JSON | ProtoPeek
pages.description: Load Cap’n Proto schemas and call concrete bootstrap methods with exact 64-bit values, verified TLS, deadlines, cancellation and JSON export.
pages.question: How do I inspect a Cap’n Proto service?

status.label: Stable · v0.7.0
status.detail: Published v0.7.0 includes bootstrap calls, generic bindings and bounded returned-capability plans. Source compilation and native endpoint acceptance remain separate.

flow.title: Choose a schema
flow.detail: Load compiled bytes or use an optional installed source compiler.

flow.title: Select a bootstrap method
flow.detail: Enter one endpoint and JSON request with a bounded deadline.

flow.title: Read the native response
flow.detail: Keep exact values, connected address, timing and transport visible.

pages.title: Website security evidence
pages.documentTitle: Website Security Evidence: DNS, TLS & HTTP | ProtoPeek
pages.description: Inspect historical certificate names and one consented public website response with bounded DNS, TLS, HTTP, header, redirect, and timing evidence.
pages.question: What can I verify about this public website?

status.label: Stable · v0.7.0
status.detail: Published v0.7.0 provides explicit website/TLS/header evidence, fixed HEAD path checks and separate historical-name lookup; no security score.

flow.title: Use one explicit action
flow.detail: Look up historical certificate names or observe one public HTTP(S) response.

flow.title: Pin the destination
flow.detail: The website action resolves public addresses, verifies TLS, reads no body, and follows no redirect.

flow.title: Treat evidence as bounded
flow.detail: Headers and certificate observations are not a vulnerability score or universal verdict.

pages.title: Network workbench

flow.title: Keep provenance visible

flow.title: Build a local evidence history

pages.title: This Device evidence

flow.title: Read the local baseline
flow.detail: Initial render reads process-perspective identity, platform capability, and interfaces only.

flow.title: Run one explicit observation
flow.detail: Listeners, connections, traffic, public identity, and speed each have separate actions.

flow.title: Keep the boundary beside the result
flow.detail: A listener is not an Internet-open port and a Cloudflare run is not ISP line maximum.

pages.title: Extensions and setup
pages.documentTitle: Extensions: Optional Tools & Setup | ProtoPeek
pages.description: Choose from 20 optional native workbenches, command and MCP setup guides, local endpoint drafts and companion links. Check only the tool you select.

flow.title: Follow official instructions

flow.title: Continue at the stated integration level

pages.title: Manage Cloudflare Tunnel locally

pages.question: Is cloudflared installed, current, and running on this host?

status.label: Stable · v0.7.0
status.detail: Published v0.7.0 includes reviewed config writes and guarded temporary Windows/Linux publishing. Installed tools, supported native lifetimes and real provider accounts remain prerequisites.

flow.title: Check the real host
flow.detail: One explicit action checks cloudflared, the canonical OS service, documented config candidates, and parsed routes including the catch-all.

flow.title: Check version freshness
flow.detail: A separate explicit action checks the official latest release and keeps download or update commands user-owned.

flow.title: Act on one canonical service
flow.detail: Start, Stop, and Restart require confirmation, a fresh expected state, post-action verification, and OS-owned elevation.

flow.title: Preview an ingress route
flow.detail: Review hostname, regex path, and origin YAML in the browser; local files and Cloudflare account configuration stay unchanged.

currentCapabilities.label: Media and webpages
currentCapabilities.summary: v0.7.0 adds native direct files, HTML media discovery and original HTML snapshots, plus explicit optional site engines with verified installation. Media remains inside the lazy Files workflow.

currentCapabilities.label: Local transfer
currentCapabilities.summary: v0.7.0 adds direct TLS 1.3 transfers between ProtoPeek devices with receiver approval, cancellation and SHA-256 receipts. Existing LAN/VPN routes carry traffic; VPN provisioning and relays are not included.

currentCapabilities.label: HTTP recipes
currentCapabilities.summary: v0.7.0 adds environment templates, session-only secrets, request-library import and reviewed cURL import. Loading prepares an unsent editor.

currentCapabilities.label: gRPC stream evidence
currentCapabilities.summary: v0.7.0 renders incremental native messages, headers and completion evidence. Local cancellation retains messages without inventing final server status.

currentCapabilities.label: Cap’n Proto plans
currentCapabilities.summary: v0.7.0 implements generic bindings and bounded typed returned-capability call plans. Review and Run are separate actions.

currentCapabilities.label: Network diagnostics
currentCapabilities.summary: v0.7.0 implements finite DNS/resolver, TCP/TLS, proxy, protocol and offline subnet checks with explicit Run/Cancel controls.

currentCapabilities.label: Packet payload evidence
currentCapabilities.summary: v0.7.0 adds default-off bounded TCP payload reconstruction with directional segments, gaps and conflicting overlaps, plus conservative snapshot comparison and Nmap-to-map previews.

currentCapabilities.label: macOS native evidence
currentCapabilities.summary: v0.7.0 implements native unprivileged ICMP and aggregate interface counters with native CI fixtures. Real runtime/intermediate-hop acceptance is separate; socket/process ownership remains unavailable.

currentCapabilities.label: Private access
currentCapabilities.summary: v0.7.0 adds a separate Headscale HTTPS login-server flow and native NetBird evidence/actions. Installed tools, accounts, permissions and real-provider acceptance remain explicit prerequisites.

currentCapabilities.label: Reviewed publishing
currentCapabilities.summary: v0.7.0 implements guarded canonical-user-config writes and owned temporary publishing on Windows/Linux. Linux requires a direct native vendor Go command. Foreground publishing remains unavailable on macOS; provider/account and cleanup acceptance stay separate.

currentCapabilities.label: Optional extension library
currentCapabilities.summary: v0.7.0 provides 20 lazy optional entries with explicit integration levels and per-entry host checks. Six are native workbenches; fourteen are setup guides or links. Opening the library installs, downloads and executes nothing.
